question: Should OpenClaw establish `rootSessionKey` and a dedicated persisted chain `traceId` as public session/Gateway metadata, and what relationship, if any, should that identifier have to diagnostic tracing?
rationale: This adds a durable cross-surface API and persisted session shape; source evidence confirms existing parent/depth data but does not define the required identifier semantics or owner contract.

options.title: Sponsor a dedicated chain contract
options.body: Add optional immutable root and chain-trace fields with one documented meaning, generated at the first spawn and propagated through native and ACP child creation.

options.title: Keep the current partial lineage surface
options.body: Retain parent/depth-only behavior and leave recursive inspection to separate tooling instead of committing OpenClaw to new durable identifiers.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a dedicated chain contract
recommendation.body: Add optional immutable root and chain-trace fields with one documented meaning, generated at the first spawn and propagated through native and ACP child creation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their issue review and recent work span the persistent session, Gateway, and protocol surfaces that must agree on the contract.
